theorem_title: Deterministic 3SUM reduction to Convolution-3SUM (Chan and He)
formal_statement: theorem Light.Sec3.ChanHe.claim_CH20_Theorem_5_1 : ThreeSumApsp.Claim.CH20_Theorem_5_1 Light.lightModel := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every fixed exponent $\kappa\ge0$, 3SUM on $n$ integers of absolute value at most $n^\kappa$ reduces deterministically to Convolution-3SUM using $n^{3/2}(\log n)^{O(1)}$ additional time, $(\log n)^{O(1)}$ oracle calls, and instances of length $n(\log n)^{O(1)}$ with polynomially bounded integers. The reduction is implemented in the light programming language with verified correctness, running time, and resource bounds.
